name: artsonia-mcp
description: Artsonia student-art portfolios, comments, and fans for Claude — access via natural language

artsonia_username.title: Artsonia Username
artsonia_username.description: Your Artsonia login email address. Required in the default direct mode; not needed when Transport is fetchproxy (the signed-in browser tab carries the session).

artsonia_password.title: Artsonia Password
artsonia_password.description: Your Artsonia account password. Required in the default direct mode; not needed when Transport is fetchproxy.

artsonia_output_dir.title: Download folders
artsonia_output_dir.description: Folders artsonia_download_artwork may save into (separate several with ':'). Leave empty to allow ~/Downloads and ~/Pictures only; any other destination is refused.

artsonia_transport.title: Transport
artsonia_transport.description: fetch (default) logs in directly with your username and password; fetchproxy is the optional fallback that rides your already-signed-in artsonia.com browser tab via the fetchproxy extension.

artsonia_ws_port.title: fetchproxy WebSocket port
artsonia_ws_port.description: fetchproxy WebSocket port override (default 37149, a shared fleet port). Only used when Transport is fetchproxy.

artsonia_inline_downloads.title: Return downloads inline
artsonia_inline_downloads.description: When on (1/true/yes/on), artsonia_download_artwork returns the images inline as base64 image blocks instead of writing them to disk; nothing is written, so dest is only a label and is not checked. Off: images are saved to disk.

artsonia_session_cache.title: Session cache
artsonia_session_cache.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

artsonia_session_file.title: Session cache file
artsonia_session_file.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.artsonia-mcp/session-<user>.json.

tools.name: artsonia_healthcheck
tools.description: Check that credentials are configured, log in, and report authentication status

tools.name: artsonia_list_students
tools.description: List all students linked to the account

tools.name: artsonia_get_activity
tools.description: Get the notification/activity feed on the parent dashboard (e.g. new teacher feedback, fan-club prompts)

tools.name: artsonia_get_artwork
tools.description: Get details for a single artwork

tools.name: artsonia_get_fans
tools.description: Get the fan list for a student

tools.name: artsonia_get_awards
tools.description: Get a student's awards and achievement badges

tools.name: artsonia_get_profile
tools.description: Get your parent/fan account profile and notification settings

tools.name: artsonia_get_feedback
tools.description: Get teacher feedback on a student's artwork

tools.name: artsonia_mark_feedback_read
tools.description: Mark all of a student's teacher feedback as read

tools.name: artsonia_download_artwork
tools.description: Download a student's artwork images to a local folder inside ~/Downloads, ~/Pictures or ARTSONIA_OUTPUT_DIR (writes files to disk)

tools.name: artsonia_post_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on an artwork

tools.name: artsonia_invite_fan
tools.description: Invite someone (by name + email) to follow a student's portfolio — sends them an invite email

tools.name: artsonia_set_notifications
tools.description: Turn the account's email opt-ins on/off (news, artist activity, promos)
